test_regex_exclude: test regex column selection with pl.col pattern and exclude method to filter out specific columns
test_regex_in_filter: test regex column selection inside filter expression with pl.col pattern matching multiple columns
test_exclude_selection: test wildcard selection with pl.all excluding columns by dtype using exclude method
test_struct_field_expand: test struct field expansion with pl.struct.field using field names, lists, or regex patterns
test_struct_unnest: test struct field expansion with pl.struct.field star to unnest all struct fields into separate columns
